name: commands-com
description: Local-first OSS CLI for review cycles and code quality workflows

scripts.validate: npm run syntax-check && npm run maintainability-check && npm run check-js && npm run coverage && npm run smoke
scripts.smoke: node ./bin/commands-com.js review "smoke test" --provider mock --json && node ./bin/commands-com.js quality --provider mock --area maintainability --json && node ./bin/commands-com.js rooms list --json && node ./bin/commands-com.js room security "smoke room" --provider mock --participants 1 --json && node ./bin/commands-com.js doctor --json
